core_capabilities: Create issues with a type, priority, title, description, reporter, and assignees.
Inspect and revise issue details, status, assignees, and priority, or delete the issue during the current session.
Plan work across backlog, selected, in-progress, and done columns by dragging and reordering issues.
Read an issue's discussion and add comments to coordinate work.
secondary_capabilities: Find relevant issues through text search and filters for assignee, personal assignments, and unresolved work.
Edit the project's name, URL, category, and description.

tasks.brief:
Restore every masked restoration stage identified below.

Restoration stage 1 - update_issue_details_and_assignee:
Restore issue-detail editing so users can change an issue’s title and rich-text description, choose its priority, and add an assignee from the issue dialog, with those edits applied to the issue’s board state.

Restoration stage 2 - update_issue_reporter_and_assignee:
Restore the issue-detail workflow for changing an issue’s reporter and then adding another project member as an assignee.

Restoration stage 3 - change_issue_type_to_bug:
Restore changing an existing issue’s type through the issue-type dropdown in the issue details dialog, with the selection applied to the issue’s project state.

The restoration is complete only when every masked restoration stage works.
